      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "Release note edits accompanying code changes belong to the feature area rather than documentation."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes Cap'n Proto mining definitions in src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp and mining interface wrappers, but does not alter IPC infrastructure itself.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The IPC category explicitly excludes PRs whose subject is what the mining interface exposes unless IPC infrastructure itself is changed."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Matched solely on a keyword in validation.cpp; does not touch mempool or policy logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR has no mempool or transaction policy components."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mining label and modifies the Mining IPC interface (src/interfaces/mining.h, src/node/miner.cpp) to support atomic precious block submission.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adding an atomic precious option to IPC block submission closes a race window against competing equal-work tips. As stated in the description, IPC mining clients previously had to make 'a separate preciousblock RPC call after submission to prefer a competing block with identical work', introducing extra round-trips and concurrency races."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp to adjust to an internal PreciousBlock function signature change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical call-site updates for an internal helper change do not constitute an RPC category change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds functional tests for interface_ipc_mining and refactors PoW grinding into a shared GrindBlock test helper.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning mining IPC behavior belong to mining, and helper refactoring across test suites is secondary."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp to extract ActivateBestChain_ and adjust PreciousBlock's signature and lock scope for caller convenience.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The validation category excludes mining PRs that refactor validation helper structures without altering validation rules or consensus behavior."
    }
  ],

  }
